citation.journal: Giornale Italiano di Dermatologia e Venereologia

record.population: No human trial of plain shea butter on skin found
record.design: PubMed searches: 'shea butter randomized', 'shea butter eczema', 'shea butter skin clinical', 'Vitellaria paradoxa human trial'
record.finding: My search found no controlled trial of plain shea butter applied to skin in any population. A 2018 review of eczema moisturisers (Micali, in the 12 Nov research file) reached the same position: shea cannot be isolated as the active.
record.note: Micali abstract was a search hit; the 'cannot be isolated' reading is from the 12 Nov research file (agent4), not re-read by me.
